results.title: Thai Customs and Australian Border Force step up fight against drug networks
results.description: BANGKOK: Thai Customs and the Australian Border Force (ABF) have agreed to intensify real-time intelligence sharing. High-risk cargo screening and detector dog (K-9) deployments under a boosted bilateral framework aimed at dismantling transnational drug smuggling rings.
